description: Defines data structures and API functions for managing vectors of expression components, including initialization, addition, conversion, destruction, dumping, and splitting expressions.

methods.name: EXPR_VECTOR_Add
methods.description: Adds a new component to the expression vector.

methods.name: EXPR_VECTOR_ToKeyValueVector
methods.description: Converts an expression vector to a key-value vector.

methods.name: EXPR_VECTOR_Destroy
methods.description: Destroys and frees resources of an expression vector.

methods.name: EXPR_VECTOR_Dump
methods.description: Outputs the contents of an expression vector for debugging.

methods.name: EXPR_VECTOR_SplitExpressions
methods.description: Splits a string into multiple expression components based on separator and valid operators.
